name: Bank of Chile
fragility_flags: DATA_GAP:sbc — sbc missing for fiscal year(s) 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3 — no tier emitted
DATA_GAP:currency — last-3-FY core facts are filed in a non-USD currency that could not be converted to USD (mixed reporting currencies, or no ECB reference rate for the currency) — no tier emitted
STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 21 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2022, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_MISSING: 20-F filer — per-share figures are per ordinary share but the traded price is per ADS; make_score refuses (DATA_GAP:ads_ratio) until judgment.json carries an ads_ratio {ratio, source, reason}
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
note: DATA_GAP: required filing data is missing (see data_gap / data_gap_uncovered). v5 never emits a tier on an uncovered data gap — a missing value is not a zero.
